cmd:
set -e
echo "=== P3 GITEA SETUP ==="

# 1. Check Gitea is running
HTTP_CODE="000"
echo "Gitea HTTP: $HTTP_CODE"

# 2. Check if API is available (already installed)
API_CHECK=
echo "API check: [$API_CHECK]"

if [ "$API_CHECK" = "{" ]; then
    echo "Gitea already configured, API works"
else
    echo "Gitea needs first-run install..."
    # Do the install
    INSTALL_RESULT=/bin/bash: line 4: -w: command not found
    echo "Install result: $INSTALL_RESULT"
    sleep 2
fi

# 3. Verify API works now
API_V2=
echo "API after install: $API_V2"

# 4. Check/create admin user tokens
TOKEN_LIST=
echo "Existing tokens: $TOKEN_LIST" | head -c 200

# 5. Create p3-relay token if not exists
P3_TOKEN_EXISTS=$(echo "$TOKEN_LIST" | grep -c "p3-relay" || echo 0)
if [ "$P3_TOKEN_EXISTS" = "0" ]; then
    echo "Creating p3-relay token..."
    NEW_TOKEN_JSON=
    echo "New token: $(echo $NEW_TOKEN_JSON | head -c 200)"
    P3_TOKEN=$(echo "$NEW_TOKEN_JSON" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('sha1','') or d.get('token',''))" 2>/dev/null)
else
    echo "p3-relay token already exists"
    P3_TOKEN=$(echo "$TOKEN_LIST" | python3 -c "import sys,json; ts=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(t.get('sha1','') or t.get('token','')) for t in ts if t.get('name')=='p3-relay']" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
fi
echo "P3_TOKEN=$P3_TOKEN"

# 6. Create relay repo
REPO_CHECK=
echo "Repo check: $REPO_CHECK"

if echo "$REPO_CHECK" | grep -q "does not exist"; then
    echo "Creating relay repo..."
    REPO_RESULT=
    echo "Repo created: $(echo $REPO_RESULT | head -c 200)"
else
    echo "Relay repo already exists or other status"
fi

# 7. Final test
FINAL_TEST=
echo "Final repo test: $FINAL_TEST"

echo "=== SETUP COMPLETE ==="
